name: Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality Dataset
description: The Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality dataset contains hourly observations of 6 primary air pollutants (PM2.5, PM10, SO2, NO2, CO, O3) and 6 associated meteorological variables (temperature, atmospheric pressure, dew point temperature, precipitation, wind direction, wind speed) recorded across 12 nationally-controlled air quality monitoring sites in Beijing from March 1, 2013 to February 28, 2017. Donated by Song Chen (Peking University) to the UCI Machine Learning Repository (DOI: 10.24432/C5RK5G), it contains 420,768 instances (35,064 records per site).
